newsitem.title: USA: Minntech says FDA investigation ends.
newsitem.headline: Minntech says FDA investigation ends.

text.p: Minntech Corp, a medical device manufacturer, said Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration completed a seven day investigation of its fiber and dialyzer product areas and found two "deviations," one of which has been corrected.

Minntech said one was previously corrected and a plan for correction has been submitted for the other. Details of the irregularities were not disclosed but the company said the deviations were insignificant in nature and did not pose a risk to public health or safety.
Minntech also said that investigators did not find any evidence to support allegations of noncompliance made by former employees.

The agency conducted a broad examination of the company's operations, Minntech said. The investigation included an in- depth review of complaint files, manufacturing lot records, device testing records, manufacturing procedures, reject reports, production records, and manufacturing process validations as well as an inspection of all manufacturing areas associated with dialyzers and fibers produced in the last 24 months, it said.

"Our operations have received intensive scrutiny from FDA and their findings confirm that Minntech is a quality oriented company producing quality products," said Louis Cosentino, Minntech chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Minntech develops technologies for use in dialysis, reprocessing and sterilants, cardiosurgery, and water purification.
